The balance sheet shows very high leverage (liabilities are about 92% of assets, with equity/assets near 8%) and weak short-term liquidity on a non-financial reading (current ratio 0.34), which constrains credit quality. Still, the issuer remains profitable with positive EBIT and substantial retained earnings, supporting a lower-investment-grade assessment rather than a speculative-grade one.

DECISION: BBB-
